scope: Negative api_base-only override to verified closed gateway-loopback port; no destination listener or secret recipient
safe_message: Authentication Error, Rejected Request: api_base is not allowed in request body. Clientside passthrough requires explicit admin opt-in via either `general_settings.allow_client_side_credentials = true` (proxy-wide) or `configurable_clientside_auth_params` on the deployment in your proxy config.yaml.
